summary_1line: Manu explains that the subtle Soul is perceived through purified understanding, not senses, and that ignorance and desire bind it to cycles of rebirth.

image_candidates.scene_text: A still pool reflecting a clear image while a nearby hand disturbs the water, blurring the reflection as a sage watches.
The moon fading into darkness on the fifteenth night while stars remain around it, symbolizing the unseen yet enduring soul.
A radiant sun withdrawing its rays back into itself at sunset as a human figure stands with senses symbolized as beams returning inward.
